name: pi-tui-status-beautifier
description: Clean up your Pi terminal status bar — formats extension badges with crisp presets (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Linear, Tokyo, Nord, Stream, Minimal, Glow), folds idle items on narrow screens, and adds live spinners.
